requirements.requirement: Collect, organise and analyse against the full list of requirements
requirements.note: This page maps each requirement to where it is met.

requirements.requirement: Executive summary outlining the important details
requirements.note: One page: the answer, six findings with sources, the decision rule and the plan.

requirements.requirement: Suggestions on improving the site, in a dedicated section, nothing implemented before review
requirements.note: 18 proposals, each marked 'for review - not implemented'.

requirements.requirement: List of questions, information and answers needed before a decision, with ways to find what is missing
requirements.note: 33 questions: what is known, what is missing, how to find out, who can answer.

requirements.requirement: Deep research on the area: geography, income, schools, population, jobs and other economic factors
requirements.status: Done for city, county and metro area; blank at neighbourhood level
requirements.note: Neighbourhood figures need the address, which is withheld.

requirements.requirement: Projection system for the area and the property
requirements.note: Official projections to 2035 and beyond, plus a scenario model with 36 labelled settings, breakevens and stress cases.

requirements.requirement: Risks for every possible decision, business-as-usual and black swan
requirements.note: 37 risks, each rated against each of six strategies.

requirements.requirement: Best decision for the property and for the owner: preservation and growth at manageable risk
requirements.status: Done as a decision rule; the final choice needs the owner's private facts
requirements.note: The rule says what to do under each answer the tenant and the advisers can give.

requirements.requirement: Verified official sources; a source link on every table row
requirements.note: 50 sources read on 2026-11-13; every row links to its source.

requirements.requirement: Blank and flagged when a value cannot be confirmed; nothing inferred
requirements.note: Blank rows are listed with the reason and how to obtain the value.

requirements.requirement: Review the repository line by line; links for manual review; flag irregularities
requirements.status: Done as a structural inventory and a cross-check of key figures
requirements.note: Every file and line is inventoried; key figures in earlier workbooks are compared with today's verified values. Not every historical sentence was re-checked.

requirements.requirement: Privacy first: no personal information, placeholders only
requirements.status: Done in the repository; not yet on the live site
requirements.note: The build scans every published file and fails on a personal identifier pattern (0 matches). The live GitHub Pages site still publishes the whole repository (source main:/), so historical pages remain reachable. See RQ-28 and COORDINATION.md (PP-03).

requirements.requirement: A live site with a clean landing page and category subpages, simple and dashboard-like, findings in tables
requirements.note: One consolidated site at the root; earlier workbooks are in the archive.

requirements.requirement: Parallel sessions coordinate through COORDINATION.md
requirements.note: A stale integration claim was taken over under the 60-minute rule; other sessions' folders are untouched.

requirements.requirement: Final integration: merge, re-verify combined data line by line, no broken links, publish
requirements.note: The verifier checks every row, every internal link in the published tree, privacy and model reproducibility.

requirements.requirement: Pull request to main with summary, sources and flagged items; merge; confirm deploy; record result
requirements.note: See the deployment page.

requirements.requirement: Flagged and unverified items on a clearly labelled Flagged for Review page with source links
requirements.note: Blank rows and irregularities, each with a link.

requirements.requirement: W-01 Replace city and county proxies with trade-area figures
requirements.status: Blocked: needs the secure location step
requirements.note: The site still uses city and county figures. A trade area (radius or drive time) must be defined in the secure workflow first, then matched to official Census tract data.

requirements.requirement: W-02 Extend the private worksheet to a sell-versus-hold comparison
requirements.note: Six-strategy scenario model, plus a browser after-tax calculator with blank inputs. The owner's rent, basis, loan and bracket are still needed and stay offline.

requirements.requirement: W-03 Decision-gate progress board
requirements.note: Decision-gate board with gates G1 to G7, each with what closes it and its official source. No gate is marked closed without evidence.

requirements.requirement: W-04 Parcel-level hazard screening
requirements.status: Blocked: needs the secure parcel workflow
requirements.note: Regional hazard context only. The parcel zone status is checked privately in the official maps.

requirements.requirement: W-10 One-page printable summary for advisors
requirements.note: One letter-size page for advisers, printed from the browser. Every figure links to its official source; no owner or parcel detail.

requirements.requirement: A private calculator that runs in the reader's browser
requirements.note: Every box starts blank; no network call; nothing stored. A winner appears only after every input is entered and the check box is ticked.

requirements.requirement: Neighbourhood-level data around the parcel
requirements.status: Blocked: needs the secure location step
requirements.note: Neighbourhood data needs the location, used only in the secure workflow, to select Census tracts. Public pages carry city and county data only.

requirements.requirement: An after-tax module
requirements.status: Partly met: the calculator's tax step; owner inputs needed
requirements.note: The calculator applies the verified federal, depreciation-recapture, investment-income and California rates. Basis, depreciation, loan and bracket are the owner's inputs.

requirements.requirement: Price the short-lease discount from real quotes
requirements.note: No public quote data exists. The short-lease discount stays blank until real quotes are obtained.

requirements.requirement: Tract-level trend evidence alongside the regional figures
requirements.status: Blocked: needs the secure location step
requirements.note: Trend series on the site are regional. Tract-level series have not been pulled from an official source.

requirements.requirement: Keep identifiers, lease files and owner finances offline; publish only aggregate, non-identifying findings
requirements.status: Met in the repository; not yet on the live site
requirements.note: The build rejects personal identifiers. The live Pages site still serves the whole repository (legacy source main:/). The owner must set Settings > Pages > Source to GitHub Actions (COORDINATION.md, PP-03).

requirements.requirement: Use the location only in a secure workflow to select Census tracts and local planning, traffic, school and competitor evidence
requirements.status: Blocked: needs the secure location step
requirements.note: Not built. The secure workflow does not exist yet and the public site holds no location.

requirements.requirement: Privately check seismic, flood and fire maps, engineering and insurance; stress loss of rent, repairs and exit liquidity together
requirements.note: Regional stress cases are in the model. Parcel-level map checks, engineering and insurance figures are not done.

requirements.requirement: Versioned, back-tested cash-flow model once verified inputs and comparable history exist
requirements.note: A versioned scenario model with unit tests exists. A back-test needs comparable transaction history and verified owner inputs, which are not available.

requirements.requirement: A single after-tax number the owner can compare with the hold case
requirements.status: Partly met: calculator; owner basis figures needed
requirements.note: The calculator sets after-tax cash today against the present value of renewal and gives the difference, once every input is entered and checked.

requirements.requirement: Replace regional hazard context with the parcel's actual zone status (earthquake, fire, flood)
requirements.status: Blocked: needs the secure parcel workflow
requirements.note: Same dependency as RQ-21. Not done until the parcel is screened in the secure workflow.

requirements.requirement: Same-store sales, unit counts, closures and franchise rental revenue shown as direction over time, not one quarter
requirements.status: Partly met; two quarters and two fiscal years
requirements.note: Same-store sales for two quarters and two fiscal years, and unit counts at two dates. More quarters are needed before the direction is reliable.
